nodes.source_text: Pt1/(Co, Ni)(OH)2/C nanostructure exhibited a far superior HER activity (24 mV @ 10 mA cm-2 with a Tafel slope of 28.7 mV dec-1)... TOF was 5.950 H2 s-1... 115.9 times over the commercial 20 wt% Pt/C... 3.5 times over 20 wt% Pt/C (ECSA normalization).

Pt1/Co(OH)2/C (50 mV @ 10 mA cm-2, 48.7 mV dec-1). The highest turnover frequency (TOF, s-1) of Pt1/(Co, Ni)(OH)2/C was 5.950 H2 s-1... which was ~7.0 times that of Pt1/Co(OH)2/C (0.855 H2 s-1 per active site).
Pt1/Ni(OH)2/C (55 mV @ 10 mA cm-2, 52.1 mV dec-1)... 12.3 times that of Pt1/Ni(OH)2/C (0.485 H2 s-1 per active site).
commercial 20 wt% Pt/C (29 mV @ 10 mA cm-2, 32.5 mV dec-1).
negligible attenuation after the chronopotentiometry test at 100 mA cm-2 for 24 h... After the renewal of the electrolyte, Pt1/(Co, Ni)(OH)2/C showed a negligible increase (by only 6 mV).
negligible decline of the HER activity after tuning the scan rate of 50 to 200 mV s-1... polarization curves of Pt1/(Co, Ni)(OH)2/C showed a much smaller increase in overpotential (21 mV).

Pt1/C displayed a significant reduction in HER performance after only 5 min at 100 mA cm-2... increased by 181 mV after 24 h... overpotential (at 10 mA cm-2) still increased by 143 mV. Tafel slope was 56.0 mV dec-1. TOF was 0.385 H2 s-1.
